Play your own audio through a Tapo camera speaker. C210 is the primary model.

The app follows the system language. English is the default. Turkish is used when the system language is Turkish.

## Download

- Windows x64: `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-win.zip`
- macOS Apple silicon: `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-arm64-mac.zip`
- macOS Intel: `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-mac.zip`
- Linux x64: `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-x86_64.AppImage` and `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-amd64.deb`
- Linux arm64: `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-arm64.AppImage` and `Tapo.Ses-0.1.0-arm64.deb`

On macOS, if Gatekeeper reports the app as damaged, right-click `Ac.command` and choose Open.

Android source is in the `android` directory. Open it in Android Studio and run the app module.

## This release

- The window is a camera list, a playback deck, and a sound library.
- MP3, WAV, M4A, and OGG are converted to 8 kHz mono PCMA.
- Audio goes to the camera talk channel on TCP port 8800.
- The computer and the camera must be on the same network.
- Sign in with the Tapo account password. The RTSP password is not accepted. The password stays on the device.
- Camera list, sound library, and level (0–150) stay on the device.
- Built-in sounds: Bell, Alert, Welcome.
- One playback is limited to 90 seconds.
- Models: C210, C200, C220, C225, C100, C110, C310, C320WS, C500, C510W, D230.

The C210 speaker is telephone quality. Short announcements are clearer.
